args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-RELEVANT-REFERRAL-TRIAL under valid ownership. Use the committed publication receipt and link-check readback to identify which workflow page already refers readers. Review seq 16 also records an earlier invoice-to-catalogue link candidate, so verify the live page before assuming coverage. Within the mission's two-FETCH allowance, confirm the strongest relevant live route and the diagnostic destination. If the link already serves the workflow, preserve the live evidence and close with a lesson. If a relevant step lacks a link, stage the smallest bilingual insertion and verify reverse restoration. Request independent review of the exact digest only if the checkout matches the live baseline and there is no competing revision. No deployment. Keep exposure, requests and revenue distinct.

description: Treasury is unfunded and reports no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The catalogue trial saved one command after setup in synthetic testing. The next test is distribution: check whether readers already preparing Shopify CSVs have a direct route to the existing diagnostic. Reuse a relevant live link if one exists.
